parsed.note_claim: The regular Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train was struck by a drone, while Boris Johnson and Günter Sautter were on a separate chartered train that was not hit but stopped nearby.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Eine russische Drohne hat am Sonntagmorgen die Lokomotive des internationalen Passagierzugs von Kiew nach Warschau getroffen.
parsed.reason: The article states the Kyiv-Warsaw train's locomotive was hit and that a separate privately chartered special train carrying Sautter and Johnson had to stop near the border during the drone alert.
